projectState.summary: Byte L1d is implemented on codex/byte-l1d-prosody-anchors from origin/main e7f2dae. generateProsodicMelody() keeps returning PlayerPatternSource but now builds generateProsodicAnchorPhrase() and renders it through renderAnchorPhrase(). The native phrase has two segments, a breath, pickup anchors, dominant question and tonic answer cadences, and connector-based fill/approach motion. Candidate-store, scoring, evolution, playback, transport, and persistence consumers are unchanged.
